title: Serry Beach Resort
description:
Well located in Hurghada, Serry Beach Resort provides air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a fitness center. With a private beach area, the property also features a terrace, as well as a bar. The property has a kids' club, room service and currency exchange for guests.

At the hotel, each room is equipped with a closet. Each room has an electric tea pot and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries, while selected rooms come with a kitchenette equipped with a microwave. Guest rooms at Serry Beach Resort are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box.

The breakfast offers buffet, continental or Full English/Irish options. At the accommodation you'll find a restaurant serving African, Middle Eastern and Seafood cuisine. Vegetarian, halal and gluten-free options can also be requested.

Serry Beach Resort has a playground. You can play pool, table tennis, and darts at the 5-star hotel.

Speaking Arabic, German, English and French, staff at the reception can help you plan your stay.

Popular points of interest near the hotel include Albatros White Beach, Marina Sports Club Beach and Old Vic Beach. Hurghada International Airport is 1.2 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

The Brothers Pyramids View is in a traditional area of Cairo (Giza) that is up-and-coming and being revitalized, just like the New Grand Egyptian Museum, a short drive up the street. The hotel is located on the fourth and seventh floors of a new building and offers a variety of rooms from standard to Luxury with a view, for individuals and your family. To best help you recognize the building, we have added a photo of the building in your Room Photo Gallery. Among the Hotel's facilities are a restaurant for breakfast and drinks, offsite food service, a 24-hour front desk and Free WiFi.

The Brothers Pyramids View's roof terrace has a grand view of the three Great Pyramids. The roof terrace restaurant is open for breakfast from 8:30am to 10am. It is open for drinks and offsite food service all day until 12am.

Continental and vegetarian breakfast options are available every morning.

At the hotel, all the rooms come with air conditioning, comfortable chairs, coffee and tea in the room, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries. Hair dryers by request. At the Brothers Pyramids View, rooms come with 100% cotton bed linen and towels.

The Giza Pyramids and Sphinx are 1.1 mi (5 min) from the hotel. The Grand Egyptian Museum is 3.8 mi (11 min) from the Hotel. The Cairo Tower is 6.8 mi from the property. The nearest airport is Sphinx International, 18 mi from Brothers Pyramids view, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

City pyramids inn in Giza offers a sun terrace and a lush garden. Guests enjoy free WiFi throughout the property, ensuring connectivity and comfort.

Comfortable Amenities

The bed and breakfast features private check-in and check-out services, a 24-hour front desk, and a concierge. Additional facilities include an outdoor fireplace, lounge, and shared kitchen.

title: Guests Pyramids Hotel
description:
Guests Pyramids Hotel is a recently renovated apartment in Cairo where guests can make the most of its casino and garden. This beachfront property offers access to a balcony, free private parking, and free Wifi. The family-friendly restaurant serves African and American cuisine, as well as Argentinian and Belgian dishes.

The apartment provides guests with a terrace, mountain views, a seating area, satellite TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven, and a shared bathroom with walk-in shower and bathrobes. A microwave, a toaster, and fridge are also available, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. Additional in-room amenities include wine or champagne, fruit, and chocolates or cookies.

Buffet and à la carte breakfast options with warm dishes, local specialities, and fresh pastries are available. There is a coffee shop, and packed lunches are also available.

Yoga classes and fitness classes are arranged at the fitness room in house. For guests with children, Guests Pyramids Hotel features an indoor play area, outdoor play equipment, and a baby safety gate. Skiing and cycling can be enjoyed nearby, while a ski equipment rental service, ski-to-door access and a ski pass sales point, are also available on-site.

Great Sphinx is a 5-minute walk from the accommodation, while Giza Pyramids is 0.9 miles away. Cairo International Airport is 19 miles from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

title: Serry Beach Resort
description:
Well located in Hurghada, Serry Beach Resort provides air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a fitness center. With a private beach area, the property also features a terrace, as well as a bar. The property has a kids' club, room service and currency exchange for guests.

At the hotel, each room is equipped with a closet. Each room has an electric tea pot and a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries, while selected rooms come with a kitchenette equipped with a microwave. Guest rooms at Serry Beach Resort are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box.

The breakfast offers buffet, continental or Full English/Irish options. At the accommodation you'll find a restaurant serving African, Middle Eastern and Seafood cuisine. Vegetarian, halal and gluten-free options can also be requested.

Serry Beach Resort has a playground. You can play pool, table tennis, and darts at the 5-star hotel.

Speaking Arabic, German, English and French, staff at the reception can help you plan your stay.

Popular points of interest near the hotel include Albatros White Beach, Marina Sports Club Beach and Old Vic Beach. Hurghada International Airport is 1.2 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

description:
This Marriott resort features an extensive pool, health club and its own island with a private beach. All rooms offer views of the Red Sea.It is a 10-minute drive from Marina Hurghada.

The rooms are equipped with 32-inch satellite TV, a mini-bar and safe box. The bathroom includes a hairdryer and bidet.Some rooms include a balcony with a sea view.

For guests’ convenience, the Hurghada Marriott Red Sea Resort provides beach towels and sun loungers. The hotel’s large open patio offers a pleasant place to relax with an Egyptian water pipe or a drink.

Hurghada Marriott is located 5 mi from the downtown Al-Dahar district. The airport is just a 10-minute drive away.

Bright, colorful rooms and suites include satellite TV, air conditioning and minibar fridge. Some rooms have pool or Red Sea views from your private terrace.

Local and international cuisine is provided in the main restaurant and there is also a steak and seafood restaurant. Snacks and fresh juices are available at the beach or outdoor pool.

Shopping malls, supermarkets and the Naama Bay market are within walking distance of the property. Sharm El Sheikh International Airport is 12 miles away by car, and Ras Muhammad National Park is a 30-minute drive away.

The spa includes reviving treatments, foot-bath, massages, relaxation programs, and beauty services with an added charge.

JAZ Belvedere is just 6.2 mi from Sharm El Sheikh International Airport and 12 mi from Sharm El Sheikh town center.

title: Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh
description:
Rediscover World-Class Luxury at Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt

Located on a one-mile stretch of private beachfront, Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt is a luxurious oasis between the desert and the reef with year-round sunshine, sleek modern accommodations and panoramic Red Sea views. Boasting 5 outdoor pools, 10 al fresco dining experiences, a highly acclaimed spa, fun-filled Kids For All Seasons club and an expertly run PADI dove center combined with one of the best house reefs in the region and a funicular that transports guests from peak to beach.
The resort’s spacious guest rooms and oversize suites range from one to four bedrooms, with a choice of modern design or traditional Arabian décor. All featuring a private balcony or terrace, some with a private pool and kitchen or kitchenette – ideal for families, group travelers and couples. Each accommodations offers comfortable living areas with a flat-screen TV, the legendary Four Seasons bed and expansive spa-like marble bathrooms aglow with sunlight.

Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh offers a stellar culinary experience ranging from Pan-Asian, Italian, Lebanese and Latin American cuisines as well as a bare-foot chic beach bar and authentic lounge with daily live entertainment.

The resort offers a special program for younger guests with a daily schedule of games, arts and crafts, cultural immersion and active play including a space reserved just for teens as well as professional babysitting services in addition to 4 tennis courts.

The Spa blends the latest wellness innovations with authentic Egyptian traditions. Offering 12 treatment rooms including a lavish couple’s suite and two outdoor cabanas facing the Red Sea, a lap pool, beauty salon and state-of-the-art fitness center. Other facilities include meeting and wedding venues with dedicated staff as well as expert concierge services.

Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh is a 10-minute drive from Sharm El Sheikh International Airport, a 25-minute drive from Naama Bay. Old Sharm with its traditional markets is 40 minutes away by car.

title: Casa Do Cairo-Sharm Alsheikh
description:
A recently renovated apartment, Casa Do Cairo-Sharm Alsheikh offers accommodation in Sharm El Sheikh. This property offers access to a terrace, free private parking, and free Wifi. Guests can make use of the outdoor fireplace or the picnic area, or enjoy views of the city and inner courtyard.

At the apartment complex, all units include air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a kitchen, a dining area, and a private bathroom with bathrobes, a bidet, and free toiletries. A fridge, a stovetop, and minibar are also featured, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the apartment complex, units come with bed linen and towels.

Guests can eat at the on-site family-friendly restaurant, which is open for dinner, lunch, brunch, and high tea.

The apartment also provides a plunge pool and a hot tub for guests to relax in. Bike rental and car rental are available at this apartment, and the area is popular for walking tours. Guests can enjoy the indoor pool at Casa Do Cairo-Sharm Alsheikh.

SOHO Square Sharm El Sheikh is 10 miles from the accommodation, while Ras Mohammed National Park is 19 miles from the property. Sharm el-Sheikh International Airport is 8.7 miles away, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

title: Sharm Holiday Resort
description:
The 4-star Sharm Holiday Resort combines elegantly furnished rooms surrounding the outdoor pool and a private beach. It includes 2 restaurants, 3 bars and a fitness center. Free Wi-Fi is available.

Spacious, air-conditioned rooms feature a satellite TV, minibar and private balcony or terrace. All rooms offer views of the pool and gardens and some have views of the Sinai Mountains.

Sharm provides guests with buffet or menu options. There are lobby, beach and pool bars and a Bedouin-style hut for relaxing.

Sports facilities such as tennis and racquetball are available and there is a health club with hot tub and sauna. Diving and snorkeling can be arranged at the 24-hour front desk.

Ras Muhammad National Park is 15 miles away. Sharm el-Sheik International Airport is a 20-minute drive away and a shuttle can be arranged.

title: Tolip Resort El Galala Majestic

title: Swiss Inn Teda Hotel & Aqua Park
description:
The Teda Swiss Inn Plaza Hotel is set amid lush gardens at the entrance of Chinese- Egyptian Economic Zone. Guests can make use of the free WiFi in the entire hotel, the pool and the 24-hour room service.

The modern, air-conditioned rooms at Teda Swiss Inn feature balconies overlooking the pool and garden. Each offers a flat-screen TV, a desk, a mini bar and wardrobe. A shower is fitted in the bathroom.

A buffet-style breakfast is served daily. Hot drinks are offered at the coffee shops. Refreshing cocktails are found at the Fun Pub and bar.

Guests can enjoy an energizing workout at the gym or relaxing massage treatments at the spa complemented by the billiards and the games room available on site. Wonderful & colored new escape family hotel extension for families with kids.

Aqua Park has 2 swimming pools and 1 heated swimming pool for children. The Fun Valley features 31 real size dinosaurs and variety of games. Auto World offers racing experiences to guests. Guests also have access to a lovely beach away 15 minutes from our hotel by free shuttle bus every hour till sun set.

Cairo is 75 mi away. Ironing and laundry can be arranged by the 24-hour front desk. Free private parking is possible on site.

title: Ghazala Oasis
description:
Elegant Accommodations

Ghazala Oasis in Dahab offers a resort with a private beach area, sun terrace, and lush garden. Guests enjoy free WiFi, a modern restaurant, and a variety of amenities including air-conditioning, balconies, and private bathrooms.

Comfortable Facilities

The property features a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and free parking. Additional services include a paid shuttle, outdoor fireplace, and family rooms. Free WiFi is available throughout the resort.

Dining Experience

The family-friendly restaurant serves halal and vegetarian meals with pizza options. Guests can enjoy lunch and dinner in a modern ambiance, making mealtimes enjoyable for all.

Activities and Surroundings

Ghazala Oasis offers snorkeling and scuba diving in the surrounding area. Dahab Beach is a 17-minute walk away, and Sharm el-Sheikh International Airport is 58 mi from the resort.

description:

All rooms have a simple, modern décor and are equipped with satellite TV and a small sitting area. Each room has a private bathroom.

Hotel Dahab Divers features a well-equipped dive center. Its trained instructors teach free diving and provide beginner courses.

Dahab Divers can organize sightseeing trips to local attractions including Abu Gallum and Petra. Local excursions such as 4x4 safaris and camel trips can be arranged.

It is located less than 37 miles from Sharm el-Sheikh International Airport.

Fitted with typical Egyptian textiles, rooms at Resta Port Said Hotel come with large windows looking out onto the canal or the city. All rooms are air conditioned, equipped with satellite TVs and include private bathrooms.

Guests can enjoy a fusion of Egyptian specialties and Italian classics at the hotel's restaurant. They can also enjoy drinks at the bar and relax on the terrace, facing the extensive gardens with swimming pool.

Popular nearby attractions include the pharaonic ancient obelisks and the iconic Suez Canal Authority Headquarters, less than a 10-minute drive away. Free private parking is available on site.

title: Helnan Auberge Fayoum
description:
Founded in 1937, the luxurious hotel has been the official host of celebrities and prominent figures over the years.

Spread over the fabulous coasts of Lake Karoun, the former hunting lodge of King Farouk offers an elegant atmosphere and a number of activities. Enjoy the unspoiled countryside and take a stroll along the golden sandy beach. Go fishing, boat sailing or windsurfing. Take a short excursion to visit the famous Seven Waterwheels or explore the unique rock formations of Valley of the Whales.

Whatever you choose to do, the Auberge is the ideal base which also provides you with luxuriously furnished and tastefully furnished rooms. Relax in the tranquil and peaceful atmosphere of your room and quietly admire the stunning view of the landscape. This is truly an oasis and your perfect place to rest.
